question.de: Wie finde ich Kliniken für eine bestimmte Behandlung?

faq.title: FAQ
faq.description: This section answers the most common questions clinics and medical networks have about gaining international patients through our comparison platform. It provides clarity on regions, qualifications, visibility and how clinics connect with international patients across the DACH region and Europe.

items.question: How does this platform help clinics gain international patients?
items.answer: By combining global visibility, patient guidance, and quality-focused clinic presentation in one trusted comparison environment.

items.question: Are the patient inquiries exclusive?
items.answer: Patients contact clinics directly. There are no resold or recycled leads.

items.question: Which countries and regions are covered?
items.answer: Our primary focus is the DACH region (Germany, Austria, Switzerland), while also supporting international patient acquisition across Europe.

items.question: Is this platform suitable for clinic groups and networks?
items.answer: Yes. We support single clinics, clinic groups, and medical networks with scalable visibility options.

items.question: Are patient inquiries focused on Europe?
items.answer: Most inquiries originate from patients seeking treatment within Europe, with a strong focus on the DACH region.

hero.title: About findmydoc
hero.description: We build findmydoc so patients can compare clinic information with more context, and clinics can present their services responsibly.

items.text: Profile claims, qualifications, reviews, prices, and contact options often arrive as separate signals.
findmydoc gives those signals a shared comparison surface before a patient starts a clinic conversation.
The comparison stays outside medical advice and keeps the decision boundary visible.

team.name: Volkan Kablan
team.whatWeDo: Sets partner standards so commercial decisions stay transparent and aligned with responsible clinic relationships.

team.name: Youssef Adlah
team.whatWeDo: Keeps clinic communication grounded in clear service claims instead of overstated promises.

team.name: Anil Gökduman
team.whatWeDo: Shapes comparison flows around patient questions, so profile signals become easier to evaluate.

team.name: Özen Günes
team.whatWeDo: Keeps privacy, legal, and consent expectations visible in patient and clinic interactions.

team.name: Sebastian Schütze
team.whatWeDo: Maintains the platform architecture that keeps profile signals structured, reliable, and accessible.

items.text: Clinics remain accountable for the information shown on their profiles.
Qualification and evidence signals are reviewed before they are presented as trust context.
Comparison context stays separate from medical advice, and patients contact clinics directly.
